[ASSISTANT_SAID] After drafting the Declaration, Adams and Jefferson remained friends but became political rivals, with Adams serving as the second president and Jefferson as the third.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The final draft of the Declaration did not mention slavery but included language about "unalienable rights."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Another disagreement was over the tone and style of the document; Adams wanted a strong declaration, while Jefferson preferred a more poetic approach.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The final draft blended both styles and has become an important document in US history.
